package imported_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	svc "example.com/imported/gen/field_names"
	pb "example.com/imported/gen/grpc/proto_fields/pb"
	grpcserver "example.com/imported/gen/grpc/proto_fields/server"
	server "example.com/imported/gen/http/field_names/server"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
)

func TestImportedFieldIdentityWire(t *testing.T) {
	const value = `{"@type":"at","type":"plain","type2":"suffix","foo-bar":"dash","fooBar":"camel","user_id":"underscore","userId":"camel-user","nested":{"@id":"at-id","id":"plain-id"},"base":{"type":"base","error":2},"derived":{"@type":"derived-at","type":"derived-base","type2":"derived-suffix","error":3}}`
	const failure = `{"@type":"failure-at","type":"failure-base","error":4,"errorField":5,"errorField2":6,"loomErrorName":"ordinary","@loomErrorName":"at-error"}`
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, path, body, response string
		status, calls              int
	}{
		{"named and inherited", "/value", value, value, http.StatusOK, 1},
		{"inline", "/inline", `{"@id":"at","id":"plain"}`, `{"@id":"at","id":"plain"}`, http.StatusOK, 1},
		{"error methods", "/value", value, failure, http.StatusBadRequest, 1},
		{"inherited required", "/value", `{"derived":{"type":"x"}}`, "", http.StatusBadRequest, 0},
		{"inherited minimum", "/value", `{"derived":{"error":0}}`, "", http.StatusBadRequest, 0},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			calls := 0
			endpoints := &svc.Endpoints{
				Value: func(_ context.Context, raw any) (any, error) {
					calls++
					if tc.name == "error methods" {
						var err svc.Failure
						require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(failure), &err))
						require.Equal(t, 4, err.ErrorField3)
						return nil, &err
					}
					return raw.(*svc.ValuePayload).Body, nil
				},
				Inline: func(_ context.Context, raw any) (any, error) {
					calls++
					body := raw.(*svc.InlinePayload).Body
					return &svc.InlineResult{ID: body.ID, ID2: body.ID2}, nil
				},
			}
			mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
			server.Mount(mux, server.New(endpoints, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
			request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, tc.path, strings.NewReader(tc.body))
			request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			recorder := httptest.NewRecorder()
			mux.ServeHTTP(recorder, request)
			require.Equal(t, tc.status, recorder.Code, recorder.Body.String())
			require.Equal(t, tc.calls, calls)
			if tc.response != "" {
				var want, got map[string]any
				require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal([]byte(tc.response), &want))
				require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(recorder.Body.Bytes(), &got))
				require.Equal(t, want, got)
			} else {
				require.Contains(t, recorder.Body.String(), "error")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestImportedFieldIdentityProtobuf(t *testing.T) {
	plain, suffix := "plain", "suffix"
	original := &pb.EchoRequest{Type: &plain, Type2: &suffix}
	wire, err := proto.Marshal(original)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var request pb.EchoRequest
	require.NoError(t, proto.Unmarshal(wire, &request))
	payload := grpcserver.NewEchoPayload(&request)
	require.Equal(t, &plain, payload.Type3)
	require.Equal(t, &suffix, payload.Type2)
	response := grpcserver.NewProtoEchoResponse(payload)
	require.Equal(t, original.Type, response.Type)
	require.Equal(t, original.Type2, response.Type2)
}
